title: PROPOSED v1.1 — recorded fields on the Hub's issued invoice record (response_snapshot.response.invoice)
description: PM-ordered extension shape (PM ORDER 9 P-01). UNCONFIRMED U14: proposed, additive, optional; the frozen Hub does not emit these fields yet. RECORDED VALUES ONLY — the Cloud never computes, infers, defaults, or enriches them. remaining_balance is a recorded value, never computed. currency_unit is the per-store unit AS RECORDED (rial|toman), never assumed. Amounts are unscaled integers in the recorded currency_unit. Invalid v1.1 content fails the ingest transaction (fail closed, no partial projection). No legal or tax meaning is attached to any field.

customer_name.description: Optional customer display name, recorded as delivered.

payments.description: Optional list of recorded payments. Never used to compute anything.

currency_unit.description: Per-store currency unit AS RECORDED by the Hub. When absent, no unit is assumed; v1.0 *_rials field names remain the record.

remaining_balance.description: RECORDED remaining balance in currency_unit. NEVER computed by the Cloud (not payable − Σpayments, not any other derivation).
